properties.name: jeap.reaction.observer.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Reaction Observer is active. Every value but true (case-insensitive) switches it off: the service then observes and reports nothing.

values.description: Reaction model version 1: the events and commands a service sends.
Reaction model version 2: adds the outgoing HTTP requests of a service. Requires a Reaction Observer Service that supports reaction model version 2.
